architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management lib (use React context if needed).

tickets.title: Create Pricing System page (src/pages/PricingSystem.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React. Include header, hero section, pricing tiers, features grid, CTA. Use Tailwind classes from design. Responsive layout.
acceptance_criteria: Static data for now; API integration later

tickets.title: Build Services Pricing page (src/pages/ServicesPricing.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement service pricing table. Include service cards, pricing details, comparison toggle. Use shared Table component from TASK-004.
acceptance_criteria: Table sorting/filtering disabled for now (static data)

tickets.title: Create 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement brutalist 404 page. Include error message, home link, pixel-art graphic. No dynamic data.

tickets.title: Build shared UI components (src/components/)
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from showcase screens. Create: Button, Badge, InputSelect, Table, Toast, Loader. Use Tailwind for styling. Props for variants (size, color, state).
acceptance_criteria: Components match Stitch showcase designs exactly

tickets.title: Implement Toast system (src/components/Toast.jsx + context)
tickets.description: Create Toast component and context provider. Support success/error/warning/info variants. Auto-dismiss after 5s. Stackable toasts. Use React context for global access.
acceptance_criteria: Toasts dismissible via close button or timeout

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Create app shell with navigation bar. Routes: / (PricingSystem), /services (ServicesPricing), * (NotFound). Navigation links match design. Dark/light mode toggle (static for now).
acceptance_criteria: Navigation links active state matches current route
Responsive nav bar (mobile menu optional for now)
